messages:
jana: heads-up: customer 'Aster' pushed a small custom token set and a LoRA. I did a local merge into redwood/pegasus-15b:lora-aster-2026-03-20 and created a micro quickpack. link: gs://redwood/onboard/aster/micropack
jana: request: quick int8 vs int4 + tokenizer roundtrip check. also verify that tokenizer preserves <AST_USER> token id 60012 across save/load.
omar: I'll run quick token roundtrip then an EM/BLEU probe. command I used:
```
ri eval run --pack gs://redwood/onboard/aster/micro-50.json \ 
  --model redwood/pegasus-15b:lora-aster-2026-03-20 \ 
  --quant int8 --seq_len 512 --batch 16 --out /tmp/aster_int8.json
```
qa-bot: queued job 10011
qa-bot: result int8: { dataset: aster-50, model: pegasus-15b:lora-aster, quant: int8, EM: 78.5, BLEU_code: 29.4, halluc: 5.4, p95_ms: 315 }
qa-bot: queued job 10012 for int4
qa-bot: result int4: { dataset: aster-50, model: pegasus-15b:lora-aster, quant: int4, EM: 75.1, BLEU_code: 23.2, halluc: 9.8, p95_ms: 250 }
omar: token roundtrip check shows <AST_USER> id=60012 preserved in tokenizer save/load but embedding table packing for int4 changed the internal offsets, causing some embeddings to shift. grep shows:
```
2026-03-20T02:11:04Z WARN embed_pack.cc: index_shift detected for ids >=60000 after quantize pack
```
jana: seems similar to other cases. for this customer we should mark int4 as unsupported until we implement embedding-exclude for reserved ids. short-term: route them to int8. 
omar: I'll file a ticket and attach logs. ticket: INF-6432
jana: please also validate 2 long-context samples (4k) before we sign off. I won't push to staging until long-context stabilized.
qa-bot: queued job 10013 for 4k long-run int8
qa-bot: result 4k int8: { EM: 77.0, halluc: 6.0, p95_ms: 1220 }
jana: long-context perf is acceptable. routing decision: default int8, flag int4 opt-in with risks. I'll update onboarding checklist. :memo:
